overall_assessment: Extraction faithfully copies what the #right-main selector sees; random controls (2020-2024) are complete, structured plans. The 20 'short' suspects are all 2023 autumn pages that carry only the facts box and no plan text on the page itself (nothing prose is uncaptured), so they are stub plans in the source rather than extraction losses. Only minor cosmetic defects remain.

findings.description: Short flags are real in the sense that the extracted text holds only the facts box (credits, department, responsible, semester, programme list) with no learning outcomes, content, teaching or assessment. The packet's uncaptured text shows only the breadcrumb, so the page itself has no plan: the extraction is faithful and these are plan-less stubs (2023 autumn master theses, practice, reduced-credit courses). They look like valid records downstream but have no plan content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: UiA's 2023 autumn pages for these codes were published without plan text in FS; not an extraction defect.
findings.suggested_fix: Mark offerings whose extracted text has no plan heading (Læringsutbytte/Innhold/Eksamen) as 'no plan' (e.g. in the gaps target) so they are excluded from section analyses; optionally try the neighbouring year's page for the same code.

findings.description: Offerings tagged Høst (autumn) show 'Undervisningssemester: Vår' in the facts box, so the semester metadata on the page disagrees with the offering. The URL is the per-year /host/ page, so the plan year is right, but the semester field cannot be trusted for the offering's semester.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: FS stores a teaching semester on the course, not the offering; the page is the year page for the course.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not derive semester from the page's Undervisningssemester; use the offering's own semester field.

findings.evidence: REL420 Religion og samfunn 1: Religion i Norge (Høst 2021)
findings.description: The page title differs from the offering's title (Skolens kontekst - religion og livssyn i Norge) for the same code; the page is the code's plan but may be a renamed or merged course, so the title/content could belong to a different version of the course.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Course renamed between metadata source and FS page; page is year-specific by URL.
findings.suggested_fix: Flag offerings whose page title differs strongly from the metadata title for manual review; no extraction change needed.
